scope: Known-development diagnosis after fixed joint training; no checkpoint selection or refitting
checkpoint: Fixed epoch24 even if some guarded proposals rejected; never best-development checkpoint
removal_policy: Input information replaced by fixed TRAIN means before both inherited and new visual pathways; body/task/clocks/labels stay original. Not a physiological neuron lesion.
report: Full and after3sec steering/forward RMSE; TRAIN mean and zero baselines; compare source v6 and counterfactuals independently on each of2 original development episodes
gates: steering better than TRAIN mean and source
forward better than TRAIN mean and source
limitations: Development already explored, not blind evaluation. No braking labels, desired speed fixed30kmh, no closed-loop, fast-path, physiology or lap qualification.
